CommanderCompanion

Commander Companion

A free companion tool for tabletop Magic: The Gathering Commander games. Track public game state, record real cards, block known illegal plays, and optionally give newer players guidance without replacing the physical game.

Choose Tracking Mode

Choose Device Setup

Every new game receives a room code when networking is available. Single-Device games keep all prompts on one screen. Multi-Device games give each player a private controller. Host Mode adds a dedicated neutral dashboard and GM tools.

What this tool does

Commander Companion is a public-state tracker and play assistant for real tabletop Commander. It is designed to reduce clerical work while keeping cards, choices, and gameplay at the table.

Guided PlayLegal-action menus, optional tips, player directions, smart mana recommendations, and plain-English explanations.
Play Tracker OnlyTraining wheels removed. Counters, card inputs, game activity, and illegal-play blockers remain.
Host + Player RoomsNeutral host dashboard plus individual player perspectives on phones, with private hand identity kept off the host display.
Automatic Public StateLife, poison, library count, mana use, card zones, commander tax, and other known outcomes update from recorded plays.
Smart ManaGold-bordered Total Mana stays static for battlefield capacity while Available Mana tracks what can still be used this turn; payments tap sources automatically.
Game ActivityOne chronological feed combines play history, pending stack items, resolution controls, host corrections, and undo history.
House RulesIndependent rules toggles let the table relax specific restrictions without turning every legality check off.
Commander FlairEach player panel automatically themes itself from the chosen commander's color identity.
Need help? Use the floating ? Help button on every screen for a contextual screen legend.
Free companion-tool disclaimer: Commander Companion is an independent, free companion component for tabletop play. It is not a replacement for physical Magic cards, official rules documents, judges, or Wizards of the Coast products. Magic: The Gathering and related names are property of their respective owners.

Commander Companion V0.5.1 — Version Notes

V0.3 is a visual-only master-theme rebuild across the entire application. The industrial Commander Companion identity now extends from Home through setup, multiplayer lobbies, player cards, game controls, combat, Deck Builder, Learn Center, Profile, post-game reports, chat, Host View, GM Options, dialogs, status symbols, and responsive phone/tablet layouts. The approved skull-and-CC gear identity is now the master brand, with distressed steel surfaces, restrained burnt-orange command accents, angular control plates, condensed industrial typography, and the reference-style active-player frame. Existing gameplay and rules logic is preserved, including camera card tracking, blocker confirmation and complex-combat safeguards, draw/cleanup confirmations, multiplayer readiness gating, Host/GM tools, and Deck Builder beta.
